reviewBoundary: Explicit new English learning passages and task responses for advanced, junior and senior learners. Frozen originals supply matching level and task-family rules only. findings: Kept the model inference local to the tested shoulder movement; no claim that all seams were intentional or that the new dancer recreated the original performance.

questionAudits.evidenceQuote: For the exhibition photograph, Mara wanted the coat to hang symmetrically.

questionAudits.evidenceQuote: continuing repairs to several torn stitches
